# `gateway.status`

Report model-gateway policy: BOTH egress switches (operator + separate EXTERNAL), provider/model, allowed data classes. Disabled by default; the kernel never needs it.

- **group:** `read`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice gateway-status`
- **MCP tool:** `gateway_status`
